observations.behavior: Adds a markdown documentation entry for the new dashboard.
observations.code_quote: The `new-marketing-analytics-dashboard` preview uses a compact section selector. The selected traffic section shows its description once above the metrics. Buttons wrap when the scene narrows, including when a side panel is open.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides release notes and user-facing documentation for the dashboard, not implementation.

observations.behavior: Changes conditional rendering of Attribution and Retention tabs based on a new dashboard feature flag.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a feature flag check to hide the Attribution and Retention tabs when the new dashboard is enabled, while retaining the old behavior when the flag is absent.

observations.behavior: Adds assertions and interactions for collapsed state of suggested conversion goals and ad sources.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds tests for the collapsed state and review actions of suggested conversion goals and ad sources, not implementation.
